nodes.label: src/fluent/generated/keys.ts
nodes.rationale: Fixed canonical path mapping Now.ID[...] identifiers to real sys_ids; artifacts without an explicit $id depend on it. Moving or omitting it from a commit mints fresh sys_ids on the next build, turning an update into an insert and duplicating records on the target instance.

nodes.label: SDD Phase State Machine (PHASE_ORDER / PHASE_TRANSITIONS)
nodes.rationale: propose->spec requires an approved proposal artifact, and a failed verify loops back to apply; these two transitions are enforced in code, not by convention, and each phase writes a typed record into x_1733631_now_code_sdd_artifact.

nodes.label: generated/keys.ts (conventions)
nodes.rationale: Has a FIXED canonical path and MUST always be committed; moving it mints new sys_ids for every artifact without an explicit $id, turning updates into inserts and corrupting the target instance (per now-sdk explain ci-integration).

nodes.label: Gentle AI SDD methodology
nodes.rationale: Chosen as the core planning methodology (explore/propose/spec/design/tasks/apply/verify) with user approval required at key checkpoints, per product.requirements.

nodes.label: now-sdk build --frozenKeys safety net
nodes.rationale: Fails the build if any artifact would mint a new sys_id; paired with a mandatory dist/app md5sum before/after comparison (ignoring the known sys_module timestamp exception) because a structural refactor can pass the type check and produce a clean build while silently re-identifying every record.
